2608.15804.method: HalluSpan/EviAlign masks output spans and trains an encoder using faithful versus hallucinated output annotations, then aligns output tokens to source tokens. Conflict detection remains difficult despite source similarity.
2608.15804.adaptation: Keep complete evidence and separately test identical, removed and mismatched sources in later capture.
2608.15804.difference: Nine-feature multivariate radial response risk does not reproduce the trained token encoder, span objective or evidence alignment. Source interventions are controls, not fitted features.

2503.21076.method: KAC applies Gaussian radial bases to individual normalized embedding channels and combines channel weights for class incremental vision classification.
2503.21076.adaptation: Use local Gaussian compatibility features with equal information and center capacity controls.
2503.21076.difference: Carnot computes squared Euclidean distance across nine dimensions to whole-vector centers; its fit geometry, delayed error selection and response target differ from KAC's univariate additive channel classifier.

2511.12828.method: The study relates KAN forgetting to activation support overlap and intrinsic data dimension, with vulnerability in high dimensional image and language tasks.
2511.12828.adaptation: Seal independent within-run retention predictions before opening human targets.
2511.12828.difference: Gaussian centers have noncompact support and changing response-risk coefficients; spline locality results and KAN-LoRA knowledge editing do not certify this kernel's retention.

2602.02634.method: A continuous-time reduction separates learning regret from delay induced drift in convex online optimization and bandit settings.
2602.02634.adaptation: Preserve issuing states, original clocks and release at slot plus twenty.
2602.02634.difference: Adaptive center installation and empirical admission change the basis and policy; the convex reduction and its regret guarantees are not implemented.

2606.11711.method: Capacity constrained delayed convex optimization tracks finitely many pending observations; untracked feedback is lost. Randomized scheduling and importance weighted learners obtain specific regret bounds.
2606.11711.adaptation: Freeze pending capacity thirty two and permanently record oldest item overflow losses.
2606.11711.difference: Deterministic eviction, changing radial centers and empirical guards do not implement the paper's weighted scheduling reduction or inherit its theorems.
